decisions.reason: The transactional email service is featured on the home page and extends the firm's core messaging infrastructure, so it is a strategic growth offer.
Document capture has its own dedicated page and supports the firm's move toward electronic document workflows and digital business processes.
Email and fax conversion uses the firm's established fax and email platform at low marginal cost and serves regulated customers who still depend on fax.
This feature sits close to the core fax delivery service, so keeping it costs little and improves service quality.
Sandbox threat protection meets growing security demand and strengthens the email security portfolio.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a natural part of the managed email security bundle and is cheap to maintain.
